name: Steal a Garden!🌽
desc:
🌱 Welcome to Steal a Garden!

You find a beautiful farm filled with plants, flowers, and crops... and spot your chance to make some quick cash. Sneak in, steal what you can, and sell it to the nearby selling point before the angry farmer catches you!

[How to Play]:
• Steal plants. 🌸
• Sell for coins. 💰
• Upgrade to become better.⚡
• Decorate your greenhouse. 🏡
• Find rare plants. 🌺

🎁 Join our group for rewards! 👍 Like the game if you're having fun!
